notes.title: Pulse Shift has been updated to 1.5.1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25922987/cb90bd83ae7e45bf962d3fb987af04bda3087988.png[/img]

Hello,

Pulse Shift has been updated to 1.5.1.

Changelog:

- Increased tolerance for falldamage
- Perception mode now reveals also time rapture if present in level
  (for achievement)
- Added ability to unlock whole game soundtrack (28 tracks) instead of 4 tracks per chapter
  (Options-Sound)
- Added ablity to swap mouse buttons
  (Options-Controls)
- Fixed various minor issues 
- Fixed achievement unlocking issues 

Regards,
3 Core Studio.
